## Description

#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/area dashboard

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Bumping `@mui/material` to 9.1.1 broke the Vitest unit test suite. The new version imports `react-transition-group/TransitionGroupContext` as a directory path inside `@mui/material/internal/Transition.mjs`, which is not supported by Node's ES module resolver, causing `UsageBar.test.js` and `ErrorMessage.test.js` to fail before running any tests.

The fix adds `@mui/material` and `react-transition-group` to `server.deps.inline` in `cmd/kueueviz/frontend/vite.config.js`, so Vitest transforms these packages internally instead of passing them to the native ESM resolver, unblocking the MUI upgrade from #12180.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #12202

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
None.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?
```release-note
NONE
```
